# Tombsteel Armor

_Rare (requires attunement by a creature proficient in heavy armor)_  
_Heavy Armor (Any, Nonmagical)_

Tombsteel was the hallmark alloy of the final Empyrean era—its cold silence a grim echo of that civilization's decline.

---

## Armor Properties

- **Type**: Heavy Armor (Any, Nonmagical)
- **Weight**: +15 lbs over base
- **Stealth**: Disadvantage

---

## Effects

- **Cold Eternal**  
  While wearing Tombsteel Armor, any creature **without resistance or immunity to cold damage** must make a **DC 13 Constitution saving throw** at the **end of each hour**.

- **Unyielding Defense**  
  Gain a **+1 bonus to AC** due to the unnerving rigidity and unnatural construction of the armor.

- **Grave Chill** _(Passive – 10 charges)_  
  The armor stores **up to 10 charges**, regaining **4 + 1d4 charges** at **midnight**. When a creature hits you with a **melee weapon attack**, you may expend **1 charge** to deal **10 cold damage** to the attacker.
